name: Webhooks
summary: One private URL. A direct line to your phone.
description: Connect anything that can send an HTTPS POST request to a personal webhook in Nudge. Get a notification when work is done or something needs your attention.
requirements: A personal hook created in the app
A tool that can send HTTPS POST requests

steps.title: Create your personal hook
steps.body: In Nudge, open You → Personal hooks and create a hook. Give it a useful name, then copy its private URL.

steps.title: Keep the URL private
steps.body: Anyone with this URL can send to this hook. Save it as a secret in your tool, not in source code or a shared chat.

steps.title: Connect your tool
steps.body: Send a POST request to the URL with Content-Type: application/json and a message field. Personal hooks notify your own account and need no separate API token.

note: Notifications depend on connectivity, device permissions and Focus settings. Personal hooks send text messages to your account.

name: Python
summary: Let your script tell you when it’s finished.
description: Step away from a long-running script. Use Python’s built-in HTTP tools to notify yourself when a task completes.

steps.title: Create your personal hook
steps.body: In Nudge, open You → Personal hooks and create a hook. Give it a useful name, then copy its private URL.

steps.title: Keep the URL private
steps.body: Anyone with this URL can send to this hook. Save it as a secret in your tool, not in source code or a shared chat.

steps.title: Send after your task
steps.body: Run this snippet when your task finishes. Handle network errors in your workflow and avoid repeating requests whose outcome is uncertain.

code:
import json
import os
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

request = Request(
    os.environ["NUDGE_WEBHOOK_URL"],
    data=json.dumps({
        "message": "Your Python job is complete."
    }).encode("utf-8"),
    headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
    method="POST",
)
with urlopen(request, timeout=15) as response:
    print(response.status)
note: This recipe uses the Python standard library. No separate Nudge SDK is required.

name: Shell & cURL
summary: A small command. A useful heads-up.
description: Add a personal notification to a shell script, scheduled job, or build workflow with a simple HTTPS request.

steps.title: Create your personal hook
steps.body: In Nudge, open You → Personal hooks and create a hook. Give it a useful name, then copy its private URL.

steps.title: Keep the URL private
steps.body: Anyone with this URL can send to this hook. Save it as a secret in your tool, not in source code or a shared chat.

steps.title: Add your notification
steps.body: Run the command at the point where a notification is useful. This example sends a fixed message without automatic retries.

code:
curl --fail-with-body --max-time 15 \
  --request POST "$NUDGE_WEBHOOK_URL" \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"message":"Your build is ready to review."}'
examples: A scheduled command needs a check
note: This is a general HTTP recipe. Your runner must support outbound HTTPS.

name: JavaScript
summary: Turn a server-side event into a nudge.
description: Use fetch in a server-side JavaScript workflow to notify yourself about a useful event. Keep the webhook away from browser code.

steps.title: Create your personal hook
steps.body: In Nudge, open You → Personal hooks and create a hook. Give it a useful name, then copy its private URL.

steps.title: Keep the URL server-side
steps.body: Save it in your server’s secret environment. Never embed the URL in a public website or browser bundle.

steps.title: Send when it matters
steps.body: Call the webhook after the event you care about. An accepted request is not proof that a phone displayed the alert.

note: Personal hooks notify your own account. Register as a platform to send notifications to your product’s subscribers through the platform API.

name: Automations
summary: Your workflow runs. Your phone keeps you posted.
description: Connect a workflow tool that supports custom HTTP requests. Add a Nudge webhook step after the event you care about.
requirements: An automation tool with an HTTPS request action
A plan that allows custom HTTP requests

steps.title: Choose your trigger
steps.body: Start with an event your tool already supports: a task finishing, a row changing, or a scheduled check.

steps.title: Add an HTTP request
steps.body: Choose POST, paste your private webhook as the URL and set Content-Type to application/json.

steps.title: Write a useful message
steps.body: Send a JSON body with a message field. Keep the text brief and avoid sensitive customer or account information.

steps.title: Test once
steps.body: Trigger the workflow once and check your Nudge inbox. If it arrives silently, review your phone’s notification permissions.

examples: A scheduled check finds a change
note: This guide uses a generic HTTP action, not a native integration or partnership with a specific automation provider.

name: IoT & devices
summary: A little signal from the things around you.
description: Connect a device or home-automation hub that can make HTTPS requests, and turn useful events into personal notifications.
requirements: A device or trusted hub with HTTPS POST support

steps.title: Choose an event
steps.body: Pick a non-critical event, such as a print completing or a home routine finishing.

steps.title: Connect through your hub
steps.body: Configure your device or hub to POST to the private webhook using Content-Type: application/json and a message field.

steps.title: Set sensible limits
steps.body: Use a threshold or cooldown in your automation so repeated sensor changes do not overwhelm your notifications.

note: Compatibility depends on your device or hub. Nudge is not an emergency alarm or a substitute for a dedicated safety system.

name: ChatGPT
summary: Ask for a nudge when your task is done.
description: The Nudge plugin connects supported assistant tasks to your personal webhook. Request a completion notification or enable optional alerts for longer tasks.
requirements: Access to the Nudge plugin preview
A supported ChatGPT or Codex environment

steps.title: Get preview access
steps.body: The plugin is in preview. Contact Nudge support for availability. A public installation link is not available on this page yet.

steps.title: Connect and configure
steps.body: Once you have access, connect Nudge and save your webhook in Configuration. Do not paste the URL into a shared chat.

steps.title: Ask for an alert
steps.body: Select Nudge and ask your assistant to notify you when the task is done. Optional automatic alerts apply to eligible tasks lasting five minutes or more.

code: Review this work and nudge me when it’s ready.
note: Assistant notifications are best-effort and depend on the host running the tool. They may not arrive after interruption, app closure or network failure. Automatic alerts do not run for every task.

name: Odoo CRM
summary: Your next lead. Your next follow-up. Right on your phone.
description: Receive Odoo CRM push notifications on your mobile with Nudge. Stay close to new leads, assignments, customer replies and follow-ups, even when you’re away from your desk.

seo.title: Odoo CRM Mobile Push Notifications | Plug & Nudge
seo.description: Receive Odoo CRM push notifications on your mobile. Get lead assignments, activity reminders and customer replies with Nudge. Setup guide for Odoo 19 and 20.

requirements: An Odoo 19 or 20 database with CRM and module import available
An Odoo administrator to install CRM Push Alerts
Nudge on your iPhone, with notifications allowed
Your own active personal Nudge webhook and the appropriate CRM access

steps.title: Get Nudge on your phone
steps.body: Install Nudge — Alerts That Matter on your iPhone, sign in and allow notifications. Android is coming soon.

steps.title: Copy your personal webhook
steps.body: In Nudge, create or choose a personal hook and copy its private webhook URL. Use a hook connected to your own account.

steps.title: Connect your Odoo profile
steps.body: Open My Preferences → Nudge → Manage my webhook. Read the data-sharing notice, paste your webhook and choose Save webhook. Each employee connects once.

steps.title: Check your first alert
steps.body: Ask your administrator to create a test lead assigned to you. In Scheduled mode, allow time for the next scan. Confirm the notification on your phone and open Learn more to check the record.

examples: A new lead is assigned to you
A follow-up activity is due today
A customer replies to a CRM conversation
note: Your webhook is private. Clearing it in Odoo stops future alerts. Phone delivery also depends on connectivity, notification permissions and Focus settings.

product.headline: Receive Odoo CRM push notifications on your mobile.

benefits.title: Catch the next opportunity.
benefits.body: Know when a lead is created or assigned to you. See the record context before you return to your pipeline.

benefits.title: Keep the follow-up moving.
benefits.body: Get activity, closing-date and inactivity reminders so the next conversation is easier to remember.

benefits.title: Pick up where it happened.
benefits.body: Use Learn more to open the relevant Odoo record. Your existing sign-in and CRM permissions still apply.

product.notificationExample:
Lead assigned · Website refresh
Assigned to: Priya Sharma
Assigned by: Arun Mehta

installSteps.title: Choose the matching version
installSteps.body: Download CRM Push Alerts for your database’s Odoo version. Check CRM access, module import availability and your subscription. Test on a duplicate database first; back up before upgrading.

installSteps.title: Install the module
installSteps.body: An administrator enables developer mode in Odoo Settings, then opens Apps → Import Module and uploads the matching ZIP. Install the nudge_online module. The import menu depends on administrator access and your database’s features.

installSteps.title: Choose your delivery settings
installSteps.body: Open Nudge → Delivery settings. Leave Scheduled selected for the default workflow, enable database notifications and choose the alert types and reminder policy your team needs.

installSteps.title: Invite your team to connect
installSteps.body: Give employees the appropriate native CRM access, then ask each person to save their own webhook using the steps below. Installing the module does not subscribe every employee automatically.

deliveryModes.title: Scheduled
deliveryModes.body: The default. Core Odoo scheduled actions check saved CRM state every five minutes. Scheduler delays and batches can take longer. Supports 24 observable alert types; reminders follow the scheduler.

deliveryModes.title: Immediate
deliveryModes.body: Optional event delivery through Odoo Automation Rules, supporting all 26 alert types. Automation Rules can affect your Odoo subscription. A Settings administrator must review and acknowledge the warning before enabling it. Reminders remain scheduled.

recipientGroups.title: The relevant person
recipientGroups.body: Lead updates normally reach the assigned salesperson. Activity alerts go to the relevant activity assignee; mentions go to the mentioned employee. Unassignment can notify the former salesperson.

recipientGroups.title: Oversight by choice
recipientGroups.body: Settings administrators can watch selected accessible leads or opt into broader oversight. Being an administrator alone does not subscribe you to every lead. CRM managers without Settings rights do not gain these controls.

product.privacy: Saving a webhook is your opt-in to send selected CRM notification content to Plug & Nudge. That content can include lead or contact names, assignee or actor names, conversation excerpts, dates and record links. Odoo remains the system of record; this is not a full CRM synchronization. Access checks still apply, and clearing your webhook stops future alerts.

faqs.question: How do I receive Odoo CRM push notifications on my mobile?
faqs.answer: Install CRM Push Alerts in your supported Odoo database, download Nudge on your iPhone and save your personal webhook in My Preferences → Nudge → Manage my webhook. After your administrator enables the relevant alert types, assigned CRM events can reach your phone.

faqs.question: Does it work with Odoo One App Free?
faqs.answer: Scheduled mode uses core Odoo scheduled actions and does not require Studio or Automation Rules. It was tested on an Odoo Online 20 database that remained on One App Free. Check your own database’s import features, subscription and current Odoo terms. Immediate mode requires Automation Rules and can change your plan status.

faqs.question: Which Odoo versions are supported?
faqs.answer: Use the matching package for Odoo 19 or Odoo 20. Odoo Online packages still need to match the database framework version. Odoo 18 is unsupported; intermediate SaaS builds need a separate compatibility check.

faqs.question: Is the integration free?
faqs.answer: The CRM Push Alerts module is free under LGPL-3.0. Your Odoo subscription requirements and Nudge service terms apply separately.

faqs.question: How quickly will an alert arrive?
faqs.answer: Scheduled mode checks saved CRM state every five minutes; delays and batching can take longer. Immediate mode captures supported events promptly, but delivery is best effort. Reminders remain scheduled. Phone permissions, Focus settings and connectivity can affect what you see.

faqs.question: Why haven’t I received an alert?
faqs.answer: Check that your saved webhook is active and belongs to your Nudge account. Review the database notification switch, selected alert type, assignment and CRM access. In Scheduled mode, allow for the next scan and reminder timezone. Then check your Nudge inbox, mute settings and phone notification permissions.

faqs.question: Can I receive alerts for Sales, Accounting or other Odoo apps?
faqs.answer: This package currently covers CRM leads, opportunities, related activities, reminders and conversations. Sales orders, Accounting, inventory, calendar meetings and digests are outside its scope. Contact Nudge support to request additional notifications.

faqs.question: Will existing leads send historical alerts when I connect?
faqs.answer: Existing records are baselined without historical creation alerts. Scheduled scans see saved state, so intermediate changes between scans can be missed. They cannot reconstruct earlier changes from before the first baseline.

faqs.question: Can I use Android or open the record from my phone?
faqs.answer: Nudge is publicly available on iPhone; Android is coming soon. Learn more opens the linked Odoo record, subject to your Odoo sign-in and access. A removed record intentionally has no link.

product.compatibility: Choose the ZIP for Odoo 19 or 20 to match your database’s framework version. Odoo 18 is unsupported; intermediate SaaS versions need a separate compatibility check. An Apps listing does not guarantee that your database can import modules.
product.alertNote: Your administrator chooses which types are enabled. Lead details changed and Lead removed start off. ¹ Scheduled activity completion requires retained activity history. ² Activity cancelled and Lead removed require Immediate mode.
product.deliveryNote: Scheduled mode was tested on an Odoo Online 20 database that remained on One App Free. Studio and Automation Rules are not required for Scheduled mode. Verify your own plan and module import availability. Switching back from Immediate does not uninstall Automation Rules or automatically restore Free.
product.recipientNote: Watch and oversight settings never grant extra CRM permissions. When recipient rules overlap, the same event is deduplicated so a person receives one copy.
product.moduleNote: CRM Push Alerts is free under LGPL-3.0. Odoo plan requirements and Nudge service terms apply separately.
